items.title: Apple's foldable iPhone repair could cost more than half its price, expert warns
items.summary: Repair specialist Ricky Panesar of iCorrect has told Forbes he expects replacing the inner screen on Apple’s first foldable to cost around £850, roughly $1,155, against $579 for the same repair on a Galaxy Z Fold 8. He also expects AppleCare+ per-incident fees to rise from the current £29 to nearer £100.
